tasks.description: Collect verified commands, entrypoints, and workflow constraints from executable repository sources.

steps.description: Read README.md with top-level build instructions.
Read CMakeLists.txt with target and option definitions.
Read scripts and test configs with execution commands.
Record only facts that have direct file evidence.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Audit output must list verified build, run, test, migration, and docker commands. Each extracted command must map to at least one repository file. Output must avoid speculative statements.

unit: Given README.md and CMake files as input, audit output must include a build command that matches file content.
Given scripts/check_server_roundtrip.py as input, audit output must include the focused roundtrip verification command.
Given db/MIGRATIONS.md as input, audit output must include migration order 001, 002, 003 with the one-time password migration script.

tasks.description: Update AGENTS.md with concise, source-backed instructions that reduce common agent mistakes.

steps.description: Keep short sections for build, run, test, database, docker, boundaries, gotchas.
Replace stale command paths with verified command paths.
Preserve useful existing guidance with current accuracy.
Remove generic advice without repository-specific value.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: AGENTS.md must stay compact and scan-friendly. Guidance must prioritize likely failure points such as wrong test paths and migration order. Every retained command must be verifiable from repository files.

unit: Given a draft AGENTS.md with mock section content, linter checks must confirm all sections are concise with no long tutorials.
Given a draft AGENTS.md with mock commands, validation must reject commands that have no matching source file evidence.
Given a draft AGENTS.md with mock stale paths, validation must replace invalid smoke test paths with a verified path.
integration: When connected to Task 'Audit High-Signal Repository Sources', each AGENTS.md command must match audited commands and constraints.

tasks.description: Verify final AGENTS.md accuracy, compactness, and consistency against executable repository sources.

steps.description: Cross-check each AGENTS.md command against its source file.
Confirm each AGENTS.md line addresses a likely agent mistake.
Remove ambiguous or duplicate wording from final text.

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Final AGENTS.md must include only high-signal, repo-specific instructions. Commands must be executable from the repository context. Content must remain short enough for a quick ramp-up read.

unit: Given final AGENTS.md content, section checks must confirm coverage of build, run, test, migration, docker, boundaries, and gotchas.
Given final AGENTS.md bullets, each bullet must have at least one file-backed rationale from repository sources.
integration: When connected to Task 'Draft Compact AGENTS Guidance', final validation must report zero conflicts between AGENTS.md and audited source commands.
e2e-manual: Human review can finish AGENTS.md in under three minutes while retaining enough detail to avoid common repository-specific mistakes.
